title: Find a specific point on a Gaussian

cues.en: In this video, you are going to learn the formula for a Gaussian function.
cues.zh: 這段要學高斯函數的公式。

cues.en: This is also sometimes called the bell curve or the normal curve.
cues.zh: 有時也叫鐘形曲線，或常態曲線。

cues.en: If you are not already familiar with what a Gaussian looks like, then you will soon learn.
cues.zh: 如果還不熟悉高斯函數的樣子，很快就會學到。

cues.en: And I'm sure you've seen a function that looks like this before.
cues.zh: 相信之前看過像這樣的函數。

cues.en: And then that's going to lead us into a discussion of how to find a particular point on a function.
cues.zh: 接著會討論，如何在函數上找到特定的點。

cues.en: So that's pretty cool.
cues.zh: 很酷。

cues.en: We're going to do a little bit of arithmetic, a little bit of algebra, and obviously you are going to see how all of this stuff looks in Python code.
cues.zh: 會做一點算術、一點代數，當然也會看到這些內容寫成 Python 程式的樣子。

cues.en: So let's begin.
cues.zh: 開始。

cues.en: Here is a crazy looking formula.
cues.zh: 這個公式看起來很瘋狂。

cues.en: This says Y equals E and E, here is the natural exponential that you learned about several videos ago and all of this complicated looking business.
cues.zh: y 等於 e 的次方，這裡的 e 是前幾段學過的自然指數，而這一大段看似複雜的內容，

cues.en: This is all sitting inside the exponent of E!
cues.zh: 全部都在 e 的指數裡。

cues.en: So we have a fraction minus four times the natural log of two times T squared.
cues.zh: 有個分數，分子是 -4 乘 ln(2)，再乘 t 平方。

cues.en: And T here is a vector.
cues.zh: t 在這裡是向量。

cues.en: So it's a list of time points.
cues.zh: 也就是時間點的串列。

cues.en: You can imagine, for example, that this would be a time vector and then in the denominator we have H squared.
cues.zh: 例如可以想成時間向量，分母則是 h 平方。

cues.en: This is an important parameter of the Gaussian and I will discuss in a few moments what this parameter refers to.
cues.zh: 這是高斯函數的重要參數，稍後討論它代表什麼。

cues.en: So this H is actually the denominator of the fraction that is all inside the exponent of E, so it gets a little bit hard to look at.
cues.zh: h 是這個分數分母的一部分，整個分數又在 e 的指數裡，看起來有點費力。

cues.en: So therefore mathematicians have come up with a solution for difficult looking equations like this and instead we write it like this.
cues.zh: 因此，數學家想出一個方法，處理這種難看的式子，改寫成這樣。

cues.en: So if you ever see XP and then with parentheses like this, this is not experience or experiential.
cues.zh: 如果看到 exp，後面接括號，不是指經驗之類的字。

cues.en: This is actually standing for exponent like the natural exponent.
cues.zh: 它代表指數，也就是自然指數。

cues.en: So and then all of the math that is sitting inside the parentheses is what is actually in the exponent.
cues.zh: 括號裡全部的數學內容，才是真正放在指數裡的東西。

cues.en: So the power of the natural exponential.
cues.zh: 也就是自然指數的次方。

cues.en: So these two are the same.
cues.zh: 這兩種寫法相同。

cues.en: Now, I just want to point out briefly that there are several different ways to mathematically express a Gaussian.
cues.zh: 簡短提醒，高斯函數有幾種不同的數學表示方式。

cues.en: So as you go through your adventures in mathematics and data science and engineering, physics, statistics,
cues.zh: 在探索數學、資料科學、工程、物理、統計，

cues.en: biology, you see this Gaussian all over the place, finance, it's really everywhere.
cues.zh: 生物時，到處會見到高斯函數，金融也有，真是無所不在。

cues.en: You might come across slightly different formulations of the Gaussian, but they always have the general form of E to the minus something squared over, something else squared.
cues.zh: 可能遇到稍微不同的公式，但大致都有 e 的負某個量平方，除以另一個量平方的形式。

cues.en: OK, now, you know, this is just a bunch of letters and numbers.
cues.zh: 目前這些只是一堆字母和數字。

cues.en: The real understanding of math, the real beauty and intuition of math comes from visualization.
cues.zh: 真正理解數學、感受數學的美和直覺，來自視覺化。

cues.en: That's a point that I try to stress very often throughout this course.
cues.zh: 這點在整門課，我都經常強調。

cues.en: And obviously I'm going to stress it right now.
cues.zh: 現在當然也要強調。

cues.en: So this is what this formula looks like.
cues.zh: 公式畫出來是這個樣子。

cues.en: Here we have the t axis over here.
cues.zh: 這裡是 t 軸。

cues.en: So this plotting, this variable T and this is the the Y variable.
cues.zh: 畫的是變數 t，這裡是 y。

cues.en: So this is the Gaussian function here.
cues.zh: 這就是高斯函數。

cues.en: So this is called the Gaussian curve or the Gaussian distribution or the bell curve or the normal curve.
cues.zh: 也叫高斯曲線、高斯分布、鐘形曲線或常態曲線。

cues.en: It's given a bunch of different names.
cues.zh: 有很多不同名稱。

cues.en: OK, so now I want to talk a little bit about this H parameter here and what that means for this graph.
cues.zh: 接著談這個 h 參數，對圖形代表什麼。

cues.en: This parameter is sometimes called the width of the Gaussian or the shape parameter of the Gaussian, and it's sometimes referred to as the full width and half maximum.
cues.zh: 有時叫高斯函數的寬度、形狀參數，也稱為半高全寬。

cues.en: I'm going to write out that term for you in a moment.
cues.zh: 稍後會寫出這個詞。

cues.en: But first, I just want to explain what this term means on the graph.
cues.zh: 先解釋它在圖上的意思。

cues.en: So if you look at this graph and you find the 50 percent mark between zero and the peak of this Gaussian, now this Gaussian peaks at once.
cues.zh: 看這張圖，在 0 和高斯曲線頂點之間，找到 50% 的位置。這條曲線頂點是 1。

cues.en: So 50 percent of the gain are halfway up means a value of zero point five.
cues.zh: 所以一半高度，就是 0.5。

cues.en: So we draw a line or we think about a line that goes through the Gaussian function, this y axis at point five.
cues.zh: 畫一條線，或想像一條線，在 y=0.5 穿過高斯函數。

cues.en: And then we find what are the two points where this intersects the Gaussian function.
cues.zh: 再找出它和高斯曲線相交的兩個點。

cues.en: So that's going to be these two points here.
cues.zh: 就是這兩點。

cues.en: And then we draw lines from these two points vertically.
cues.zh: 再從這兩點，畫垂直線。

cues.en: We just drop straight down to the time axis or, you know, the x axis, space axis, whatever this axis is.
cues.zh: 往下到時間軸，或 x 軸、空間軸，取決於這是什麼軸。

cues.en: And then you find what is this distance here from this point to this point?
cues.zh: 看看，這一點到另一點的距離是多少？

cues.en: So this distance here and in this case, I'll let you guess what that parameter is here, what that value is here.
cues.zh: 就是這個距離。這個例子，讓你猜猜參數、數值是多少。

cues.en: I'd say it's about one.
cues.zh: 我覺得大約是 1。

cues.en: This looks like minus point five and this looks like plus point five.
cues.zh: 這裡像 -0.5，這裡像正 0.5。

cues.en: So this total distance is one.
cues.zh: 總距離是 1。

cues.en: And that is an important feature of the Gaussian.
cues.zh: 這是高斯函數的重要特徵。

cues.en: And it is called the full width at half maximum.
cues.zh: 叫半高全寬，Full Width at Half Maximum。

cues.en: So it's the width at half of the maximum between zero and the peak or the maximum of the Gaussian.
cues.zh: 也就是 0 到頂點、最大值之間，一半高度處的完整寬度。

cues.en: So this H parameter here corresponds to the full with the maximum and for this particular graph.
cues.zh: 這裡 h 參數對應半高全寬，在這張圖裡，

cues.en: Would be equal to one, approximately.
cues.zh: 大約等於 1。

cues.en: OK, now what I want to do next is show you how to figure out what values of T correspond to any arbitrary values of Y.
cues.zh: 接著，示範給定任意 y 值，如何找出對應的 t 值。

cues.en: So, for example, if we set this equation to be one three, say one equals E to the and then all of
cues.zh: 例如，把這個式子設成 1，寫 1 等於 e 的，

cues.en: this business, my question is what value of T satisfies this equation?
cues.zh: 這一大段次方。問題是，哪個 t 值會滿足方程式？

cues.en: Where what do you set T to in order for this equation to be true?
cues.zh: 要把 t 設多少，方程式才成立？

cues.en: Now, if you'd like to pause the video and work through the algebra yourself, then that's great.
cues.zh: 想暫停、自己算代數，非常好。

cues.en: Now is your opportunity to do that.
cues.zh: 現在可以。

cues.en: OK, so the key to getting started here, because it's a bit tricky, we have the T squared inside the numerator of a fraction, which is inside the power of this exponential.
cues.zh: 開始的關鍵，因為這有點複雜：t 平方在分數分子，而分數又在指數函數的次方裡。

cues.en: The key insight is to think back a few videos ago to where I discussed the relationship between the natural logarithm and the natural exponential.
cues.zh: 關鍵是回想前幾段，自然對數與自然指數的關係。

cues.en: And you will remember that those two operations are inverses of each other, so they cancel each other out.
cues.zh: 記得，它們互為反運算，所以會抵銷。

cues.en: So therefore, the way to get started here is to take the natural log of both sides of this equation
cues.zh: 因此，先對方程式兩邊取自然對數，

cues.en: so that, look, something like this, we have the natural log of one equals the natural log of the natural exponential of this term here.
cues.zh: 像這樣，左邊 ln(1)，右邊是這整個自然指數函數的自然對數。

cues.en: Now, the cool thing is that these two operations cancel each other out.
cues.zh: 很酷的是，這兩個運算抵銷。

cues.en: They just totally disappear.
cues.zh: 完全消失。

cues.en: And that gives us and then it turns out that the natural log of one is equal to zero.
cues.zh: 得到這個，而 ln(1) 剛好等於 0。

cues.en: So this simplifies to this expression here.
cues.zh: 所以化簡成這個式子。

cues.en: And now it turns out we don't even need to really do a lot of arithmetic anymore.
cues.zh: 接著不太需要做很多運算。

cues.en: And that's because we can basically just solve this equation pretty simply by taking advantage of the fact that this is zero.
cues.zh: 因為可以利用這裡是 0，輕鬆解方程式。

cues.en: So, for example, multiply both sides of this equation by H squared.
cues.zh: 例如，兩邊都乘 h 平方。

cues.en: That's still zero over here.
cues.zh: 左邊仍是 0。

cues.en: And then we divide both sides of the equation by minus four times the natural log of two, still zero on the left side.
cues.zh: 再兩邊都除以 -4 乘 ln(2)，左邊還是 0。

cues.en: And then we take the square root to isolate T and we take the square root of zero and that gives us zero.
cues.zh: 開平方根，讓 t 單獨留下，0 的平方根是 0，所以得到 0。

cues.en: OK, so that was a lot of like algebra, analytic solutions, et cetera.
cues.zh: 做了很多代數、解析求解等等。

cues.en: But we could also have just figured that out by looking at this plot.
cues.zh: 但其實也能直接看圖得到答案。

cues.en: You know, you look at this and it's obvious that when the Gaussian equals one, we are exactly at the center and T equals zero, which is what we get here.
cues.zh: 很明顯，高斯函數等於 1 時，正好在中央，t=0，和這裡結果相同。

cues.en: So I wanted to start off with an easy example here, but it's not always so trivial to figure out this solution.
cues.zh: 先從簡單例子開始，但解答並非總是這麼容易看出。

cues.en: Let us, for example, consider the value of T when the function equals zero point five.
cues.zh: 例如，考慮函數等於 0.5 時的 t 值。

cues.en: Now, again, if you'd like to pause video and work through the algebra here, then now's your opportunity to do so.
cues.zh: 想暫停、自己算代數，現在可以。

cues.en: So we start with the same trick.
cues.zh: 先用相同技巧。

cues.en: We take the natural log of both sides of this equation.
cues.zh: 對方程式兩邊取自然對數。

cues.en: And again, we can cancel out.
cues.zh: 再抵銷，

cues.en: These are these two terms, cancel each other out.
cues.zh: 這兩項互相抵銷。

cues.en: So that gives us the natural log of point five equals the inside of the Gaussian exponential over here.
cues.zh: 得到 ln(0.5)，等於高斯函數指數裡面的式子。

cues.en: And then we just have to do a little bit of extra algebra to isolate T..
cues.zh: 再做一點代數，讓 t 單獨留下。

cues.en: So here I'm doing actually two steps at once.
cues.zh: 這裡其實一次做兩步。

cues.en: So multiply both sides of this equation by H squared and then divide by minus four times the natural log of two.
cues.zh: 兩邊都乘 h 平方，再除以 -4 乘 ln(2)。

cues.en: And that gives us this solution.
cues.zh: 得到這個解。

cues.en: And we're not quite done because we actually want the value of T and this is giving us T squared.
cues.zh: 還沒完全完成，因為要的是 t，這裡卻是 t 平方。

cues.en: So we need to take the square root of both sides of the equation, which looks like this.
cues.zh: 所以兩邊開平方根，像這樣。

cues.en: Of course, you always have to consider both the plus and minus when you're computing the square root.
cues.zh: 當然，開平方根時，要同時考慮正負兩個解。

cues.en: That's actually going to be pretty important when we switch to Python in a moment.
cues.zh: 稍後切到 Python，這點很重要。

cues.en: So there's a few simplifications we can do here.
cues.zh: 這裡還能做一些化簡。

cues.en: The main one is pulling this H parameter outside of the square root.
cues.zh: 主要是把 h 拉到根號外。

cues.en: So now we have the result that T equals plus or minus eight times the square root of this stuff in here.
cues.zh: 現在結果是 t 等於正負 h，乘這裡的平方根。

cues.en: So this is the natural log of the value on the Y axis that we are looking for divided by.
cues.zh: 這是要找的 y 軸數值的自然對數，再除以，

cues.en: This is essentially just a scaling factor, minus four times the natural log of two.
cues.zh: 基本上是尺度因子：-4 乘 ln(2)。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So this is a lot of, you know, like sort of pure math.
cues.zh: 很多純數學的內容。

cues.en: I'm sure you are super excited to see this stuff implemented in Python.
cues.zh: 相信非常期待看到 Python 實作。

cues.zh: 切過去吧。

cues.en: We will be using the Numpty and and PI plot modules here.
cues.zh: 會用 NumPy 和 pyplot 模組。

cues.en: So let's already start by importing those.
cues.zh: 先匯入。

cues.en: And I'm going to just dive right in and start creating this Gaussian.
cues.zh: 直接開始建立高斯函數。

cues.en: So the Gaussian formula, let's call that G.
cues.zh: 高斯公式叫 g。

cues.en: I guess in the slides I call this Y, but here I khalaji.
cues.zh: 投影片叫 y，這裡則叫 g。

cues.en: So we have nonpaid XP.
cues.zh: 使用 np.exp。

cues.en: Now you can see why Python developers and also in Matlab and many other numerical processing software is why they call this XP.
cues.zh: 現在知道 Python 開發者，以及 MATLAB 和許多其他數值處理軟體，為什麼叫它 exp。

cues.en: So it's to be similar to the mathematical notation.
cues.zh: 就是為了和數學符號相似。

cues.en: I introduced you to so we have the numerator was minus four times the natural log, which is nonpaid
cues.zh: 前面介紹過，分子是 -4 乘自然對數，也就是 np，

cues.en: log of two times T and then squared and then all that was divided by H squared.
cues.zh: log(2)，再乘 t 平方，全部除以 h 平方。

cues.en: OK, so now we need to define some of these variables here.
cues.zh: 現在需要定義這些變數。

cues.en: So we have T and I'm going to set that to be linearly spaced numbers from minus three to plus three.
cues.zh: t 設成 -3 到正 3 之間，等距分布的數字。

cues.en: And let's go in one thousand and one step.
cues.zh: 使用 1001 個點。

cues.en: So why am I doing one thousand and one.
cues.zh: 為什麼是 1001？

cues.en: Is it because I'm just sort of a quirky guy and I don't like even numbers like a thousand?
cues.zh: 因為我有點古怪，不喜歡 1000 這種偶數嗎？

cues.en: Well, that is that's probably part of the answer.
cues.zh: 也許這的確是部分原因。

cues.en: But actually there's a good reason for doing that here.
cues.zh: 不過，這裡其實有合理理由。

cues.en: And that's because if we want this function to have the exact number zero, the exact center, then we want zero to be in this.
cues.zh: 如果希望函數包含精確的 0，也就是正中央，

cues.en: We want to have T equals zero to be in this vector.
cues.zh: 就希望 t=0 存在這個向量裡。

cues.en: And if we go from minus something to plus something in an even number of steps, then we're not going to have zero in the middle.
cues.zh: 從負某個值，到正同樣的值，若用偶數個點，中間不會有 0。

cues.en: And if we have an odd number of steps, we are definitely going to have zero in the middle.
cues.zh: 用奇數個點，中間肯定會有 0。

cues.en: OK, and then we need to define H.
cues.zh: 接著定義 h。

cues.en: So let's add H to be how about point nine nine nine.
cues.zh: 把 h 設成 0.999，如何？

cues.en: That seems like a good number.
cues.zh: 看起來是個好數字。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.zh: 執行後，沒有任何輸出。

cues.zh: 當然沒要求輸出，只想確保沒犯簡單的小錯。

cues.zh: 接著繪圖。

cues.zh: 看看。

cues.zh: 畫 t 對 g，把 y，應該說 x 軸標籤設成 t。

cues.en: And you know, it's kind of arbitrary that I'm calling this T could call it X, you could call it S anything you like.
cues.zh: 其實叫 t 有點隨意，也可以叫 x、s，任何你喜歡的名字。

cues.zh: 我做很多訊號處理，所以常把高斯函數想成時間的函數。

cues.zh: 因此習慣用 t。y 軸標籤則叫 y，保持，

Oh, wow.
